_comment: Every server we run. The launcher shows these (dist/launcher.json is built from this file). status: public (everyone sees and plays), beta (shown with a BETA tag; the server's /aotrpg access mode beta decides who gets in), private (hidden until a player enters the server's access code in the launcher; set code to the plain code, only its hash is published), soon (shown as coming soon, no Play). pack: the packwiz folder. address: what Play joins; on Hamachi, the host's 25.x.x.x address and port. theme: the launcher's painted backdrop (aot, duel, or any other word for a plain one). art: optional image URL to use instead.

servers.name: Attack on Titan RPG
servers.description: Paradis and Marley, wall to coast. Swing through cities and giant forests, hunt titans with your squad, run the story, prestige past level 100, and when you're invited, take on extraction.

servers.name: Stancebound
servers.tagline: Martial arts duels in a ruined kingdom.
servers.description: A melee combat server built around fighting styles: learn stances, chain attacks into your own combo deck, and prove it in duels and wandering fights.
